sections.heading: What Is Tripeaks Adventure?
paragraphs: Tripeaks Adventure is a relaxed tri peaks solitaire card game about clearing table cards in smart one-rank sequences. The page is designed for instant browser play through a local wrapper.

The objective is straightforward: clear the tableau by choosing cards that are one rank higher or one rank lower than the open card. That clear goal makes the game easy to start, while better timing and planning create room to improve.

sections.heading: How to Start
paragraphs: Open the Play page and let the embedded game load. You do not need an account, a download, or a separate launcher.
Use the mouse or touch the screen to select playable cards and draw from the stock when no move is available.

sections.heading: Your First Session
paragraphs: Look for longer card chains before you tap, use the stock only when the board is stuck, and keep flexible ranks open for later moves.
Treat the first few attempts as practice. Learn what the game rewards, what causes mistakes, and how the screen communicates danger or opportunity.

sections.heading: Do Not Rush the Easy Moves
paragraphs: Most avoidable mistakes happen because the first obvious move is made too quickly. Read the full screen first.
A slower start usually creates a cleaner run, especially when the game asks for timing, memory, or planning.

sections.heading: Focus on One Improvement
paragraphs: Pick one habit to improve each session: better reading, cleaner timing, smarter spacing, or fewer panic moves.
Small improvements are easier to notice and repeat than vague goals like trying to play perfectly.

sections.heading: Replay With Purpose
paragraphs: If a run fails, identify the exact choice that made it harder. That is the useful lesson.
Then restart and adjust that one decision instead of changing everything at once.
